description: Synthetic card scans for the placeholder-pipeline E2E gate. Generated by apps/web/scripts/generate-placeholder-fixtures.py --full-bleed. FULL-BLEED cards that FILL the frame, so the NEO-175 fast path accepts them as 'frame' identity and they never escalate to the heavy service. Both lists are in UPLOAD ORDER — front/back alternation. Each front and back print the SAME full player name so the identity pool pairs them. `files` is the contract the seed page reads; `images` is the same order with the metadata a human (or a flow author picking assertions) needs.
